Xin Zhao  
📞 +91 98765 43210 | 📧 xin.zhao@advervetech.com | 📍 Bangalore, India  

During my tenure at AdVerve Technologies, I contributed to strengthening the security posture of adtech systems by configuring firewalls, implementing IAM policies, and monitoring SIEM tools. As a Security Analyst Intern, I supported the setup of network defenses, ensuring alignment with ad campaign platform requirements. In my role as Junior Security Engineer, I focused on vulnerability assessments and access control frameworks, which became foundational to my understanding of secure infrastructure. Recently, as a Security Specialist, I collaborated on SOC2 compliance audits, which required deep dives into threat modeling and system resilience. These experiences allowed me to refine my approach to identifying and mitigating risks in dynamic environments.  

Education  
Bachelor of Science in Cybersecurity, Cybersecurity Institute of Technology, 2022  

Technical Skills  
Application security (OWASP) was central to my work during vulnerability scans for ad campaign platforms, where I identified common weaknesses and recommended mitigation strategies. Cloud networking (VPC/subnets) emerged as a key consideration during SOC2 compliance efforts, where I mapped network segments to ensure isolation of sensitive data. Firewall configuration remained a recurring task, especially during the early stages of my career, where I optimized rules to balance security and operational efficiency. IAM/Access control became a core responsibility, particularly in designing policies that restricted privileges while enabling seamless user interactions. Monitoring & alerting systems, such as SIEM tools, were integral to my daily workflow, enabling real-time detection of anomalies. Network security principles guided my approach to threat modeling, where I evaluated potential attack vectors. Penetration testing techniques were applied during vulnerability assessments, simulating scenarios to uncover configuration gaps. SIEM tools were a constant focus, as their logs provided critical insights for incident response and trend analysis.  

Projects  
A key project involved enhancing IAM frameworks for adtech platforms, which required aligning access controls with business needs while minimizing exposure risks. Another initiative centered on refining firewall rules to address emerging threats, ensuring compliance with internal security standards. During SOC2 audits, I contributed to documentation that highlighted the effectiveness of network segmentation and access governance. These efforts underscored the importance of integrating security practices into every stage of system development.  

Certifications  
CompTIA Security+ (2023)  

Languages  
English (professional), Hindi (fluent)
